question: Why is this power called khecarī in this context?
premises: Khecarī fills the path from the root-support to the top of the space at the end of the twelve.
She is associated with moving and abiding in space.
She is associated with feeding on the nectar of space.
inference: The name khecarī is explained by her pervasion of the inner space and her movement, abiding, and nourishment in that space.
uncertainties: dviṣaṭka is taken as referring to the twelvefold endpoint in line with the previous verse.
plain_english: This khecarī fills everything from the root-support up to the top of the space at the end of the twelve; she is called khecarī because she moves and abides in space and feeds on the nectar of space.
